title: Career Roadmap: Cosmetologist
summary: A Cosmetologist is a beauty and personal-care professional who provides services related to skin care, hair care, makeup, nail care, and overall appearance. Depending on training and specialization, cosmetologists may work in salons, beauty clinics, spas, cosmetic retail, the entertainment industry, or their own businesses.

blocks.text: A Cosmetologist is a beauty and personal-care professional who provides services related to skin care, hair care, makeup, nail care, and overall appearance. Depending on training and specialization, cosmetologists may work in salons, beauty clinics, spas, cosmetic retail, the entertainment industry, or their own businesses.

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: Course names and eligibility vary by institution. A cosmetology qualification does not automatically authorize medical procedures or the practice of dermatology.

blocks.label: Final recommendation
blocks.text: Students pursuing a B.Voc in Beauty, Cosmetology & Wellness should prioritize hands-on practice, hygiene, client communication and one marketable specialization. Building a strong portfolio and gaining supervised salon experience are key steps toward employment or starting a beauty-services business.
